summary: Prepare energy arbitration claims, evidence maps and hearing plans. Review the five-day oil and gas arbitration course outline.
lede: Oil and gas arbitration training helps legal, contracts, claims and technical professionals assess energy disputes and build coherent case strategies. Through case exercises, participants map contract claims and procedural choices, organize operational records into evidence chronologies, and review expert assumptions when assessing production-loss quantum and preparing hearing plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, prepare or support oil and gas arbitration matters, including legal, contracts, claims and technical functions.
audience: Oil and Gas Project Controls Specialists
modules: Oil and Gas Arbitration Case Context
New York Convention and Case Reporting
prerequisites: Working knowledge of commercial contracts or arbitration is recommended. No coding or specialist software is required.
